what: Bo writes two notes and seals each alone (B). Then his copy's stored headers are changed outside the signature's reach: the first's version is stored as the one-byte blob 02, the second's lc as a one-byte blob of its own value. A stored header's version and lc are integers, and are read as stored, never converted: neither header makes a canonical header, so each is refused BATCH_SIGNATURE_INVALID in Bo's name and neither note is taken (stored-header-integers). Before, the runtime read each with Number(), which reads the blob 02 as 2, so both verified and both notes were taken (branch review pass A, M7).
